commentary.text: 90+9' Pablo Fuertes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle after Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+5' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The game is interrupted. Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
88' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is brought on as a substitute for Dani Raba.
86' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Renato Tapia will be replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
86' Substitution. Juan Cruz will be replaced by Yan Diomande (Leganes).
86' Looks like Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
84' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
84' Juan Cruz (Leganes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Andriy Lunin is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
83' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Diego Garcia is replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes).
81' Leganes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luka Modric walks off the pitch to be replaced by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid).
78' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
76' 3 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
76' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
74' Pablo Fuertes shows a yellow card to Renato Tapia (Leganes) for his blatant foul.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) for Lucas Vazquez.
69' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
66' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
66' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Yvan Neyou and he is replaced by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes).
65' It must be a yellow card. It is. Diego Garcia (Leganes) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
63' Dani Raba (Leganes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) gets a yellow card. The referee Pablo Fuertes made the right call.
62' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) replacing Brahim Diaz.
62' Here is a change. Arda Guler is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
62' It's like he was asking for a caution. Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card.
60' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
58' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

57' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
57' Dani Raba (Leganes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Pablo Fuertes blows for a foul. Real Madrid will take a free kick.
55' Pablo Fuertes blows for a foul after Luka Modric (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
54' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
53' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Marko Dmitrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
52' Pablo Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Renato Tapia (Leganes) and blew his whistle.
50' The attendance for today's match is 73641.
47' 2 - 2 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
47' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
47' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Pablo Fuertes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Good touch by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
45+2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.

45+1' That was a nice football moment. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Marko Dmitrovic guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
45+1' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Marko Dmitrovic to dive and make a save.
44' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) commits a rough challenge and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

41' 1 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Dani Raba (Leganes) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
39' Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to intercept the corner from Arda Guler (Real Madrid).

39' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Real Madrid earn a corner.
36' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
34' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Diego Garcia (Leganes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
32' 1 - 0 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) converts the penalty with ease, Antonin Panenka style.
32' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

30' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Pablo Fuertes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Real Madrid!
30' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Lucas Vazquez.
29' Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
26' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
24' It looks like Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Pablo Fuertes won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
23' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
23' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.

21' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
20' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
16' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
15' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
11' Half-chance! Luka Modric (Real Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
10' A wild pass somehow finds Yvan Neyou (Leganes) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
7' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
1' The first half has started.
